# Volu — Android Per-App Volume Control

> Volu is an Android utility application that automatically sets custom, per-app media volumes and context-aware sound profiles without requiring root.

## Overview
- **Product Name**: Volu
- **Primary Function**: Android per-app volume control and sound profile manager
- **Platform**: Android (Android 8.0 Oreo and newer)
- **Official Website**: https://volu.support/
- **Google Play Store**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tdapps.volu
- **Privacy & Security**: 100% on-device processing. No audio recording, no telemetry, no account required.
- **Permission Model**: Uses Android's standard Usage Access (`PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS`) to detect foreground apps. Does not require Accessibility Service or root.

## Key Capabilities
- **Per-App Volume Control**: Automatically remembers and adjusts the media volume when specific apps (e.g., Spotify, YouTube, Instagram, Netflix, TikTok) come to the foreground.
- **Contextual Sound Profiles**: Triggers sound scene profiles (Home, Work, Gym, Car) based on Wi-Fi SSID connections, Bluetooth audio devices, wired headphones, or scheduled times.
- **Default Catch-All Volume**: Defines a fallback volume level for unmanaged apps so users are never surprised by unexpected audio blasts.
- **Home Screen Widgets**: Includes Material 3 interactive Glance widgets:
  - 4x2 App Volumes widget for live volume adjustments directly on the home screen.
  - 3x2 / 4x2 Profile Switches widget.
  - 4x1 Profile Bar capsule widget for quick scene toggling and all-off silencing.
- **Zero Root Needed**: Operates using standard Android user permissions without custom ROMs, bootloader unlocks, or ADB commands.
